title: Third-party SDKs detected in AI apps: iOS vs Android
subtitle: 10 AI apps with both builds analyzed, latest build per platform
selection: AI assistant / AI creation apps that have an analyzed tech stack on both iOS and Android: ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Grok Bot, Kimi, Le Chat, Manus, Meta AI, Perplexity, Suno. Claude, DeepSeek, Character.AI, Copilot and others are excluded because only one platform is analyzed.
method: ios_sdks / android_sdks = 'Third-party SDKs' count on each app's /tech-stack page for the latest analyzed build. The two builds are analyzed separately and can be different versions and dates.

x.label: Third-party SDKs detected in the iOS app

y.label: Third-party SDKs detected in the Android app

ios_sdks.meaning: Third-party SDKs detected in the latest analyzed iOS build (the source tech-stack page).

biases.text: Every iOS page in this set is labelled 'Detection: lower bound': the real number can be higher (e.g. Meta AI iOS 6).
Build dates differ; stale builds are labelled on the chart.

android_sdks.meaning: Third-party SDKs detected in the latest analyzed Android build.

biases.text: Android detection is 'observed' for 6 apps and 'lower bound' for Grok, Grok Bot, Kimi and Manus, so iOS vs Android is not a like-for-like count.
Grok's Android build was analyzed in Jun 2026, four months before its iOS build.

footnote: Source: {source}, 1 Nov 2026. Latest build per platform, analyzed Jun to Oct 2026.
iOS: {n_ios_lower} of {n_rows} counts a lower bound. Android: {n_android_observed} of {n_rows} observed, so not like-for-like.
Only apps with both platforms analyzed. Builds older than 60 days are labelled.
